_note: Every gameplay number that may change, read and checked by crates/core/src/tuning.rs when the page starts. Units are in each key's name: _ms milliseconds, _mm millimetres, _mm_per_s millimetres a second, _deg degrees, _deg_per_s degrees a second, _pct percent. A missing, unknown or out-of-range key is refused by name. Other systems (fishing, items, radar, fish) add their own section here and its struct in tuning.rs.

match._note: length_ms: 8 minutes (BRIEF), the default the match setup offers among length_choices_ms. buoy_interval_ms: an item buoy every minute (BRIEF), the default among buoy_interval_choices_ms; the items system reads the match's own value (Match::setup). seats: lobby slots, coloured blue, red, green, yellow. spawn_spread_mm: the gap between neighbouring boats at the spawn, side by side across the heading.

boat._note: top_speed 16 m/s is the speed the map size was chosen for (map/mod.rs BOAT_TOP_SPEED_MM_PER_S). accel_ms: W from rest to top speed (BRIEF: about 5 s). With no throttle the boat slows from top speed to rest in coast_ms; S while moving forward brakes from top to rest in brake_ms; sideways slip dies from top speed in side_drag_ms. Turning: turn_deg_per_s once the boat moves at turn_full_at_pct of top speed or faster, turn_at_rest_pct of it at rest, and in between in proportion. In fishing mode A and D swivel the cast at swivel_deg_per_s, up to swivel_limit_deg either side of the bow. The hull for collisions: a rounded box half_length_mm plus half_beam_mm from the middle to the bow, half_beam_mm to each side. nitrous: the items system turns it on; each figure is a percent of the plain one.

wreck._note: A boat wrecks another when its speed toward it is ram_wreck_pct of top speed or more (BRIEF: 80%, judged without nitrous), and its own motor stalls for stall_ms (round 1, B1). A boat wrecks on land when its speed toward the land is land_wreck_pct of top speed or more (BRIEF: 50%); slower, it bounces back at bounce_pct of that speed and keeps scrape_keep_pct of its speed along the shore. Slower boat hits bump both boats apart at bump_pct. A wrecked boat comes back at the spawn after respawn_ms (BRIEF: 2 s), ghosted for ghost_ms (round 1, B3): it passes through boats and cannot wreck or be wrecked by one.

fish._note: The fish in the lake (crates/core/src/sim/fishing/lake.rs). Each kind's count in data/fish.json (the BRIEF's example spread) moves by up to count_variance_pct either way by the match seed; commons and uncommons swim in schools of 2-4 and rares and legendaries alone (map/fish.rs places them, at their tier's depths). A fish's length is length_min_pct to length_max_pct of its kind's base length (BRIEF: about 1.5 times). A school wanders within roam_radius_mm of where it was placed at roam_speed_mm_per_s, resting roam_rest_min_ms to roam_rest_max_ms between legs; its fish keep up at follow_speed_mm_per_s. A fish that gets free swims freed_swim_mm off at freed_speed_mm_per_s, then roams from there (the person: 'maybe they swim a bit away'). Sight: a fish shows from a boat within sight_shallow_mm when it swims at sight_shallow_depth_mm or shallower, falling in proportion to sight_deep_mm at sight_deep_depth_mm and deeper (the person: close only, but more generous for legendaries); with your line in, also within sight_lure_mm of your lure.

fishing._note: Casting, the bite and the reel (crates/core/src/sim/fishing/mod.rs). A cast is refused above cast_max_speed_mm_per_s (the person: only nearly stopped). Holding Space for charge_full_ms casts cast_max_mm, a tap cast_min_mm, in proportion between; the bobber flies for cast_flight_ms, and the lure sinks at sink_mm_per_s until Space or bed_clear_mm over the lake bed. A boat faster than drag_reel_in_mm_per_s reels an unhooked line in, and faster than drag_snap_mm_per_s breaks a line with a fish on. A roaming fish within attract_radius_mm comes over when its depth matches the lure's; with the depths attract_depth_mm apart or more, only attract_far_pct of that radius (round 1, F3). Once there it waits wait_min_ms to wait_max_ms, nibbles nibbles_min to nibbles_max times, nibble_gap_min_ms to nibble_gap_max_ms apart, then bites; Space within hook_window_ms hooks it (BRIEF: 0.75 s; a tick is 20 ms, so it runs 38 ticks, 760 ms). A catch is worth its kind's value (data/fish.json) times tier_value_pct (round 1: 1, 2, 3 and 5 times) times its length over its kind's base. camera_value_pct: the High-Quality Camera (BRIEF: 1.5 times). A landed fish is held up for landed_ms.

reel._note: The reel minigame (crates/core/src/sim/fishing/reel.rs), Stardew Valley style. Bar positions and speeds are thousandths of the bar's height. The catch zone is zone_permille high; holding Space lifts it at lift_per_s2, letting go it falls at gravity_per_s2, up to zone_top_speed_per_s either way. The catch meter starts at start_pct, fills with the fish in the zone so a perfect reel takes perfect_ms (round 1, F1: 3, 5, 10 and 20 s), and drains from full to empty in drain_ms with it out; the line breaks only when it is empty (the person's answer). The fish's marker moves at up to fish_speed_per_s, keeps a course for about fish_turn_ms, and darts to the far end of the bar fish_dart_pct of the time: rarer fish fight harder. The ratchet ticks every tick_ms while Space is held; the fish is pulled up to surface_depth_mm by the time it lands.

ai._note: The AI players (crates/core/src/ai/). They see only what their seat could: the fish in sight (Match::fishing_view), rivals within the fog distance with no land between, rivals heard within hear_mm (a rival's motor is heard from about 5 s away at top speed), their own pings, and the hook popups. Driving: a path over a grid of path_cell_mm cells, each open when all its water is path_clear_mm or more from land and dearer nearer than path_roomy_mm; with land within look_ahead_mm ahead the boat keeps under careful_speed_pct of top speed, below the 50% that grounds a boat, and it brakes with brake_use_pct of its braking. Fishing: it stops cast_stop_mm short of the fish it chose (the most points for the time it would take), casts at it, stops the lure at its depth, reels in after lure_wait_ms with nothing coming, and leaves a fish after tries_per_fish misses. Hunting: on a rival's hook it reckons the fish's points against fishing_rate_per_min of its own, and goes only if it can get there before the rival's reel ends (rival_reel_ms, a steady player's time by tier); it rams at ram_speed_pct of top speed or more (80% wrecks) after a straight run of ram_runup_mm. Evading: a rival closing faster than threat_speed_pct of top speed, who would arrive before its own reel ends, may make it drop the line and flee for flee_ms. A ping's sighting is chased for sighting_keep_ms. skill: per difficulty, the reaction to a bite, the reel's lag and noise (thousandths of the bar), the cast's aim and charge noise, aggression (how readily it hunts), the chance it evades, and how often it pings.

audio._note: Read by crates/core/src/sound/motor.rs. Gains run 0 to 1 and pitches are multiples of the recipe's own (1 is as written, 2 an octave up). Times in seconds unless the key says ms; distances in mm.

rival_motor._note: A rival's motor heard from your boat. Silent beyond the distance a rival covers in hear_seconds at the boat's top speed (the brief: about 5 s), louder as it nears, full within full_within_mm. curve 1 rises evenly, 2 slowly at first and quickly near. The true Doppler shift of a 16 m/s boat is under a semitone, so doppler_scale exaggerates it; the pitch is kept between lowest_pitch and highest_pitch.

own_motor._note: Your own motor: idle when still with no throttle, full at top speed with the throttle held. throttle_share is how much of the rise comes from holding W or S rather than from the speed.

line_tension._note: The line's whine during the reel: silent below starts_at tension (0 to 1, where 1 snaps the line), then louder and higher.

ratchet._note: The reel's ratchet clicks: clicks a second at the slowest reel and at full speed, and the click's pitch at each.

pass_by._note: The Sounds screen's pass-by: a rival at top speed on a straight line side_mm to your side, starting and ending overrun (a share of the hearing distance) beyond hearing.

radar._note: The Fish-Boy's radar (crates/core/src/fishboy/radar.rs). ping_cooldown_ms: from one ping's start to the next allowed, per player (BRIEF: 5 s). ping_sweep_ms: how long the sweep takes to cross the whole map from where the player pinged (BRIEF: about 3 s); it must end before the cooldown does.
